cases.assertion: A logged-in viewer receives bounded OpenGraph text from a public HTML page. Redis caches successful metadata, and cache failure still allows a safe fetch.
A loopback, private, link-local or cloud address is refused before connecting, including when discovered during DNS resolution or a redirect.
The outbound fetch checks each redirect and stays within the request time and body-byte budget. Clients keep the original post or message visible if no card can be shown and never load remote images.
